capabilities: Render any character task marker as a visual checkbox
Apply CSS fixes for popular community themes
Adapt rendering automatically to theme changes
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only changes how task markers are displayed, not how tasks are created or tracked.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This extends Obsidian's default behavior to support any custom workflow you can imagine.
problem: Obsidian only renders the standard task marker as a checkbox, so custom marker characters like /, > or ! stay plain text.
summary: Task marker renderer that turns any character used as a task marker into a themed, interactive checkbox in Live Preview and reading mode.
